title: Neither Names the Lot
hook: Two on the seat. Nobody mentions the lot.
scene: Overcast midday, the Menace parked in a downtown lot stall, cluster at zero. Gracie and Mya are both on the passenger seat again — orange and brown, cream chest and dark stripe — boxed earlier, loose now because you are still. Nobody says Kent. Nobody says the collar. Nobody says who held her. Two cats, one seat, the same weight as I-003 and none of the talk. The Core is a wall of brick through the mesh. You let the quiet sit.
debrief: Both cats are on the seat. Nobody names the lot. You saved the lot a sentence nobody said.

source.teaching_target: Mya beat: both cats on the seat, parked; neither Ali nor the card names the lot or the collar.
